ViGALT_ablation.alt_text: A sofa bed is arranged as a single bed. An L-shaped frame surrounds the head and right side, with open shelving illuminated by cyan LEDs. The work surface extends across the foot and right side, and a laptop sits on the work surface. Storage compartments beneath the mattress are pulled open on the left, and fabric organizer pockets hang from the near side.

claims.claim: A sofa bed is arranged as a single bed.
claims.label: AVOIDABLE_REDUNDANCY

dom_evidence.value: this sofa bed transforms into a spare bed... a child's bed, an adult bed

claims.reason: The DOM already identifies the product as a sofa bed with a 90 x 190 cm sleeping area and describes it as a single bed.

claims.claim: An L-shaped frame surrounds the head and right side.
claims.label: UNAVOIDABLE_REPETITION

dom_evidence.value: The L-shaped tray and 6 open niches

claims.reason: The DOM establishes an L-shaped component, but does not specify that the frame surrounds the head and right side. Referring to the L-shaped frame anchors the new positional arrangement.

claims.claim: Open shelving is present.
claims.label: AVOIDABLE_REDUNDANCY

dom_evidence.value: The L-shaped tray and 6 open niches to display your books, toys, baskets and decorations

claims.reason: The six open niches already explicitly convey the presence of open shelving, with no additional information in the claim.

claims.claim: Cyan LEDs illuminate the open shelving.
claims.label: NOVEL

dom_evidence.value: Customize over 60,000 colors, brightness and lighting mode

claims.reason: The DOM states that the bed has customizable LED lighting, but does not state that the LEDs are cyan or that they illuminate the open shelving.

claims.claim: The work surface extends across the foot and right side.
claims.label: UNAVOIDABLE_REPETITION

dom_evidence.value: this convertible sofa features a genuine work surface of 35x112 cm

claims.reason: The DOM establishes that a work surface exists, but not its extension across the foot and right side. Mentioning the work surface is needed to anchor the new layout information.

claims.claim: A laptop sits on the work surface.
claims.label: NOVEL

dom_evidence.value: Connect your devices (laptops, lamps and iPads) simultaneously
Storage pockets to keep your school supplies, remote controls and laptops within reach

claims.reason: Although the DOM mentions laptops as devices that can be connected or stored, it does not state that a laptop is sitting on the work surface.

claims.claim: Storage compartments beneath the mattress are pulled open on the left.
claims.label: UNAVOIDABLE_REPETITION

dom_evidence.value: 2 large drawers with wheels and storage under the 90x190 mattress

claims.reason: The DOM already establishes under-mattress drawers and storage, but does not state that the compartments are pulled open or located on the left. The repeated storage reference anchors those new positional and state details.

claims.claim: Fabric organizer pockets hang from the near side.
claims.label: UNAVOIDABLE_REPETITION

dom_evidence.value: Storage pockets to keep your school supplies, remote controls and laptops within reach

claims.reason: The DOM establishes storage pockets, but does not describe them as fabric or state that they hang from the near side. Repeating pockets is needed to identify what the new material and placement details describe.
